title: Derived complete objects
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, a scheme $Y$, and put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$. Let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_Y$ be the completed coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ the derived category of sheaves of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], with its triangulated structure [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

For $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ let

$$
 K_n=\operatorname{Res}_n\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\bigr),\qquad t_n:K_{n+1}\to K_n,\qquad c_n:K\to K_n\quad(t_n\circ c_{n+1}=c_n)
$$

be the reduction tower of $K$ with its maps from $K$ [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]: here $K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ is the derived reduction modulo $\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] and $\operatorname{Res}_n:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ the derived restriction of scalars [def-weil-integral-derived-restriction-of-scalars], so that $(K_n,t_n)_{n\geq1}$ is an inverse system in the single triangulated category $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$. The countable product $\prod_nK_n$ exists in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, represented by the termwise product of representatives, because countable products of sheaves of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules exist and are exact [lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact] and by [lem-weil-derived-limit-existence], clause 2. Let $c=(c_n)_n:K\to\prod_nK_n$ be the morphism with components $c_n$, and $1-s:\prod_nK_n\to\prod_nK_n$ the transition endomorphism of the system $(K_n,t_n)$ [def-weil-derived-limit]; then $(1-s)\circ c=0$, since its $n$-th component is $c_n-t_n\circ c_{n+1}=0$.

The object $K$ is *derived complete* if there is a morphism $\delta:\prod_nK_n\to K[1]$ such that

$$
 K\xrightarrow{\ c\ }\prod_nK_n\xrightarrow{\ 1-s\ }\prod_nK_n\xrightarrow{\ \delta\ }K[1]
$$

is a distinguished triangle of $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$; that is, if $K$ is a derived limit $R\varprojlim_nK_n$ of its reduction tower [def-weil-derived-limit] through a Roos triangle whose first map is $c$. Equivalently: there are a derived limit $L$ of $(K_n,t_n)$, with Roos triangle $L\xrightarrow{\iota}\prod_nK_n\xrightarrow{1-s}\prod_nK_n\xrightarrow{\delta_L}L[1]$, and an isomorphism $\varphi:K\to L$ with $\iota\circ\varphi=c$. (Given such $\varphi$, the triangle $(c,\,1-s,\,\varphi[1]^{-1}\circ\delta_L)$ is isomorphic through $(\varphi,\mathrm{id},\mathrm{id})$ to the Roos triangle of $L$, hence distinguished; conversely take $L=K$, $\varphi=\mathrm{id}$.)

No particular morphism $K\to R\varprojlim_nK_n$ is singled out by this definition: a derived limit is determined only up to a non-unique isomorphism, and a morphism $K\to L$ lifting $c$ only up to a morphism factoring through $(\prod_nK_n)[-1]\to L$; the condition asks only that $c$ be the first map of some distinguished triangle completing $1-s$. This is the reading, in the triangulated category $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, of the condition of Bhatt-Scholze, Definition 3.5.2, that the natural map $K\to R\varprojlim_n(K\otimes^L_{\widehat R}R/\mathfrak m^n)$ be an isomorphism, for $R=\mathcal O_E$, $\mathfrak m=(\varpi_E)$, $\widehat R=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$.

split_report.summary: Checked against Bhatt-Scholze §3.4-3.5 (pdftotext): the form 'K -> R lim(K ⊗^L A_{E,n}) is an isomorphism' is BS Definition 3.5.2 / Proposition 3.5.1(1) (p. 24), not Definition 3.4.1 (p. 21, the T(K,x)=0 form) and not Stacks 091S (also the T(K,f)=0 form, which is def-weil-point-derived-complete-module-complex); the source citations are corrected. The reductions are now the derived reductions of def-weil-integral-derived-reduction (derived tensor over the completed sheaf, landing in D(Y,A_{E,n})), carried into D(Y,O_E) by the new derived restriction of scalars node, instead of def-weil-derived-tensor (constant ring only). The tower (K_n,t_n) and the maps c_n:K->K_n are now built explicitly from a K-flat resolution in the new node def-weil-integral-reduction-tower, whose independence of the resolution is the new statement lem-weil-integral-reduction-tower-well-defined. 'The canonical map K -> R lim' is removed: with the Roos-triangle derived limit no such map is unique (a lift of c=(c_n) is determined only modulo Hom(K,∏K_n[-1]), and its uniqueness fails in general, since lim^1 Hom(K,K_n[-1]) need not vanish), so the definition now asks that c=(c_n):K->∏K_n be the first map of a distinguished triangle completing 1-s, equivalently that some isomorphism K≅L onto a derived limit lift c. Existence of ∏K_n in D(Y,O_E) is cited (lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact, lem-weil-derived-limit-existence clause 2). Dropped stmt_deps def-weil-derived-tensor and lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact (now used through the restriction node).
